title: 真实clean/smudge方向：索引存规范JSON、检出为可读JSON，必须传播过滤失败
source: 独立编审：Git对象、协作与交付审查

conversion.original_title: clean与smudge过滤器分别在哪个方向转换内容？

body:
## 操作任务
实现filter_options(script)返回恰clean/smudge/required三项，分别为调用当前Python解释器执行本题获批脚本的clean/smudge模式的shell安全命令和bool True。脚本路径可能含空格；先确认存在普通文件，不改脚本。clean从工作树输入到规范索引blob，smudge从blob到可读工作树；由Git本身调用过滤器，不预先手改文件冒充过滤成功。以调用级-c配置驱动，不持久写Git配置。原生验收git add、show :path、checkout-index和diff的真实往返；故意让clean失败时git add必须失败，旧索引blob和失败工作树内容保持。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实临时Git仓库和自有JSON格式教学过滤器，规范化保持含超大整数/UTF8/布尔/数组的JSON值；不是换行属性题、LFS下载或任意生产过滤器可信性证明。仅配置获批本地脚本，不执行外部仓库提供的未知驱动，不改OpsForge真实Git状态、默认身份或全局配置，不提交/推送任何仓库。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,json,secrets,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')}
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-filter-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);repo=root/'repo';repo.mkdir();driver=root/'approved transform helper.py';driver.write_bytes(pathlib.Path('checks/driver.py').read_bytes());driver.chmod(0o600)
 def git(*args,options=None,ok=True):
  flags=[]
  if options is not None:
   for name in ('clean','smudge','required'):
    value=options[name];value=str(value).lower() if isinstance(value,bool) else value;flags+=['-c','filter.teaching.'+name+'='+value]
  p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','core.hooksPath='+os.devnull,'-c','core.autocrlf=false',*flags,'-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf8',timeout=5)
  if ok:assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
  return p
 git('init','-b','main');attributes=b'*.json filter=teaching -text\n';(repo/'.gitattributes').write_bytes(attributes);git('add','.gitattributes')
 config=(repo/'.git/config').read_bytes();driver_hash=hashlib.sha256(driver.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 document=dict(service='Ops_'+secrets.token_hex(4)+'_你好',number=9007199254740993,enabled=True,tags=['a','b'])
 target=repo/'config.json';target.write_text(json.dumps(document,ensure_ascii=False,indent=4)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:filter_options',flush=True)
 try:options=task.filter_options(driver)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student filter configuration failed') from error
 assert isinstance(options,dict) and set(options)=={'clean','smudge','required'} and type(options['required']) is bool
 git('add','config.json',options=options)
 canonical=json.dumps(document,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n'
 assert git('show',':config.json').stdout==canonical,'clean did not convert worktree JSON to canonical index blob'
 identity=git('rev-parse',':config.json').stdout.strip();target.unlink()
 git('checkout-index','-f','--','config.json',options=options)
 pretty=json.dumps(document,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n'
 assert target.read_text(encoding='utf8')==pretty,'smudge did not convert canonical blob into display worktree'
 assert json.loads(target.read_text(encoding='utf8'))==document
 assert git('diff','--quiet','--','config.json',options=options,ok=False).returncode==0,'round-trip clean changed canonical identity'
 target.write_text('{"fail":true}\n',encoding='utf8')
 failed=git('add','config.json',options=options,ok=False)
 assert failed.returncode!=0,'required filter failure was silently replaced with unfiltered blob'
 assert git('rev-parse',':config.json').stdout.strip()==identity and git('show',':config.json').stdout==canonical,'failed clean altered staged canonical object'
 assert target.read_text()=='{"fail":true}\n' and (repo/'.gitattributes').read_bytes()==attributes
 assert (repo/'.git/config').read_bytes()==config and hashlib.sha256(driver.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==driver_hash,'default/repository config or approved script changed'
 print('NATIVE_GIT_CLEAN_INDEX_SMUDGE_WORKTREE_ROUNDTRIP_AND_REQUIRED_FAILURE_PRESERVES_INDEX',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
